ReviewRequestRemoved.description:
A pull request that left a person's review requests since the previous poll: they reviewed it,
someone removed the request, or it closed.

author.description: The GitHub login who opened it; null for a deleted user.

baseline.description: True when the event came from the first poll of its stream.

reviewed.description:
Whether the reviewer submitted a review since `since`. False means the request ended some
other way: someone removed it, or the pull request closed.

reviewer.description: The GitHub login asked for the review, as the trigger names it.

since.description: When the intake first found the request: the time of that poll.

title.description: The pull request title when the intake polled.

triggers.description: The triggers the event matched, so the triggers it requests tasks for; may be empty.

url.description: The pull request's page on GitHub.

description:
A pull request that left a person's review requests since the previous poll: they reviewed it,
someone removed the request, or it closed.

id.description: A UUIDv5 of the message's name, so a retried publish keeps its id.

links.description: GitHub and Linear events carry one link to the event's page.

subject.description: A short line for listings, such as `owner/name#42`.

title: github.pull_request.review_request_removed
